title: CondoGuard Deductible Re-Raise Share
content:
Underwriting guideline of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy on the credit for raising a deductible that was recently lowered.

**Guideline.** The re-raise share of the deductible credit looks at the latest deductible lowering on the policy, a deductible endorsement that added premium: it is 0.25 when such a lowering took effect fewer than 12 whole months before the day of the raise, 0.50 when the latest such lowering took effect 12 to 23 whole months before that day, and 1.00 when there was no such lowering or the latest one took effect 24 or more whole months before. The share is applied to the product of the annual premium in force and the deductible step credit, before the full-year deductible credit is rounded. Where that product carries more than one deductible credit share, the shares are first multiplied together and then applied once to the product; none of them acts on the result of another.

**What counts as a lowering.** A deductible endorsement on this policy whose premium direction was additional, that is one that added premium. The date that matters is the effective date of the latest such endorsement.

| Latest deductible lowering on the policy | Whole months from its effective date to the raise | Re-raise share |
|---|---|---|
| exists | fewer than 12 | 0.25 |
| exists | 12 to 23 | 0.50 |
| exists | 24 or more | 1.00 |
| none | not measured | 1.00 |

## Checks (hypothetical histories)

- Deductible lowered from 1000 USD to 500 USD effective 11 whole months before the raise: 0.25. Effective 12 whole months before: 0.50.
- Latest lowering 23 whole months before: 0.50; 24 whole months before: 1.00.
- Two lowerings, the latest 30 whole months before: only the latest is looked at, 1.00.
- Earlier deductible endorsements on the policy all returned premium: no lowering, 1.00.
